response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amount FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, avg_amount, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM g) AS diff FROM g ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
